name: engine-jobs
description: A job runner on @superschematic/engine and @superschematic/engine-workqueue: jobs claimed under leases, retried per failure class and held to a budget, workers whose presence releases their leases, and batches that stamp their steps and settle when they finish, over one SQLite file and the engine's HTTP API. scripts/link.sh puts the engine, the work-queue package and the packages they need into node_modules from this checkout; see README.md.
